context: Handling benchmarks that depend on unavailable paid services and looking up paper figures with the preferred tools.

checklist.name: Existing repro checked
checklist.description: The agent checks benchmarks/sources/ for promptsaver-repro.md first.

checklist.name: Harness located
checklist.description: The agent identifies the harness from the analysis Stage 2 section or the reference file and records its paths.

checklist.name: Blocker identified
checklist.description: The agent recognises that the harness needs a paid API with no credentials available.

checklist.name: Blocker documented
checklist.description: The Reproduction attempt section names the missing paid API access as the blocker.

checklist.name: No figures fabricated
checklist.description: No observed metrics are invented and the section states that none were obtained.

checklist.name: MCP preferred for paper lookup
checklist.description: The agent uses the semantic-scholar MCP rather than WebFetch to find the paper's accuracy figures.

checklist.name: Paper figures marked as reported
checklist.description: The paper figures are recorded in the Reported figures section, each marked (as reported).

checklist.name: How to reproduce explains what is needed
checklist.description: The How to reproduce section states the credentials and commands a reviewer would need.

checklist.name: Analysis back-filled
checklist.description: Stage 2.2 of the analysis file receives a pointer to the repro file with outcome unverified.

checklist.name: Validator run
checklist.description: The agent runs ./scripts/validate-repro-benchmark.sh on the produced file.
